 Order
Heard and perused the record.

2. This is first application filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 relating to FIR No.641/2023, dated (not mentioned)
registered at Police Station -Pithampur, District - Dhar for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376,
376(2)(n) & 376(1) of IPC, 1860 and Sections 3/4, 5l/6 & 5j(ii) of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 31.01.2024.
3. Allegation against the applicant is that of abduction and commission of rape with the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

He further submitted that the statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the trial Court and as per her statement, she has accepted that she was in love with applicant and the age of the prosecutrix is also disputed as father of the prosecutrix has also stated that she has not obtained any certificate regarding her age, hence, the age of the prosecutrix was only on the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31982 2 MCRC-45994-2024 basis of assumption.
The applicant is in custody since 31.01.2024.
Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Hence, he prays that the applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent - State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

6. Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for both the parties, custody period of the applicant as well as statement of the prosecutrix, so also the fact that final conclusion of trial shall take sufficient long time, I deem it proper to release the accused /
applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

The applicant shall abide by all the conditions enumerated u/S. 480(3) of BNSS.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
